title: Grok 4.7 added; Gemini routes adjusted
summary:
Grok 4.7, three community model routers, and MCP setup for 13 coding clients led a day of catalog and agent-tool repairs.

Grok 4.7 was added for paid requests, with reasoning, tools, structured outputs, up to 10 reference images, and a 500,000-token context window. Direct Vertex routes were restored as the primary path for six Gemini text and four Gemini image models, with fallbacks retained.

Quest contributors added polyrouter, triage-router, and tiered-health-router. Each chooses a compatible model using some combination of task complexity, price, and recent health data; their request handling and fallback behavior differ, so there is now more than one answer to the question of which model to call.

The new `polli mcp` commands list catalog servers and install, inspect, or remove them across 13 coding clients. Agent tooling also gained clearer Connected Apps discovery and fixed FFmpeg input handling; Polli's subcommand help colors are more consistent.

daily.title: Grok 4.7 joins the catalog
daily.text: Use `x-ai/grok-4.7` for reasoning, tools, structured outputs, and prompts with up to 10 reference images. It has a 500,000-token context window and requires paid access. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=x-ai/grok-4.7).

daily.title: MCP setup from Polli
daily.text: Use `polli mcp` to browse MCP servers and install, inspect, or remove them in 13 coding clients, including Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, and Zed. [Explore the CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/cli).

daily.title: Polyrouter picks a model
daily.text: Call `afanasevmylife/polyrouter` through the Responses API to route a request by complexity, model capabilities, price, and recent health. Its `polyrouter_trace` field shows the choice in Responses API results. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

daily.title: Triage-router handles fallback
daily.text: Try `community/xiaotian1171/triage-router` for capability-aware routing across fast, balanced, and deep model pools. It accepts Responses and Chat Completions requests and can choose another tier after certain model errors. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

daily.title: Tiered routing with health checks
daily.text: Try `community/tomdacatto/tiered-health-router` to classify a request as fast, balanced, or deep, then select a compatible model using catalog prices and recent health. It preserves image, audio, video, and tool-calling requirements. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).
